description: The Phase 5 demo house, read by an implementation of FS_lowvoltage that knows it: a panel, kitchen receptacles on two 20 A circuits, a toilet, a lavatory, an electric water heater on a 240 V circuit, a gas furnace and range, a bath fan, and low-voltage devices run to a structured media enclosure. It is valid, reports nothing, and derives FS_lowvoltage's values as `derived.extensions.FS_lowvoltage`.
